description: Monthly Interstate Ferry Ridership, Port Authority: Beginning 1998 is a dataset listed in State of New York open data portal (data.ny.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of New York. This dataset provides total monthly ridership trends on New York/New Jersey interstate ferry routes. It counts ridership as unlinked trips, covering both directions of travel between the two states. It includes only scheduled interstate ferry services, and excludes tour and charter trips. Coverage: New York State. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are port authority of ny & nj, transit, transportation, ferries. The table has 4 columns. Attribution on the portal: Port Authority of NY & NJ. The portal shows 2016-10-11 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-ny-gov-portal.
